title: Firefox browser profiles
whyItMatters: Firefox profiles keep separate histories and saved logins. The number and names of profiles show how the browser was divided up.
source: Firefox profile location on macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Firefox/Profiles - https://github.com/RyanDFIR/hindsight
notes: Profile folders have random names such as xxxx.default-release. prefs.js is present in each profile; the file is never opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Firefox open the passwords page and use Export Logins, then export bookmarks to a file you keep.
cleanup.signOut: In Firefox open the sync settings and disconnect this device, so the Mozilla account no longer holds its data.
steps: Close every Firefox window so the profile files are not in use.
Move Firefox to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the Firefox folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Firefox profile on this Mac: history, cookies, saved logins and bookmarks.
cleanup.source: Mozilla Support, Export login data from Firefox: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/export-login-data-firefox
